info.title: Panneau protocol
info.description: The HTTP API between a Panneau frontend and its backend. Paths are relative to `api.baseUrl` of the definition. Authentication is up to the backend (session cookie or bearer token). Errors use `application/problem+json`.

get.summary: The definition for the current user, in the current locale.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Lists whose `pagination` is `cursor`: the `nextCursor` (or `previousCursor`) of a page, instead of `page`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields; a `-` prefix sorts descending.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: `filter[status]=published`; `filter[tags][]=a&filter[tags][]=b` for any of several values; `filter[published_at][from]=2026-01-01&filter[published_at][to]=2026-01-31` for the inclusive bounds of a range filter (`date-range`), without the open end.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to include in each item.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Clients never parse or generate ids.

Abilities.description: What the current user can do, keyed by ability (`viewAny`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, or an action id).

route.description: Name of a route in the definition.

field.description: Field name, or a dot path.

Condition.description: A condition on form values: compare one field (`equals`, `in`, `notIn`, `filled`), or combine conditions with `all` or `any`.

tone.description: The tone of the option where it shows as a badge, in lists and details: `neutral` (the default), `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, or a tone of the theme.

ratios.description: A crop must have one of them: its height is within one pixel of its width divided by the ratio, after its rotation.

required.description: Each image needs a crop for this use.

anyOf.description: A rule added in a later version of the protocol. Clients that don't know it ignore it; the server still enforces it.

Rule.description: A portable validation rule. `min` and `max` apply to numbers, and to the length of text and arrays. `accept` lists MIME types (`image/*`). `maxSize` is in bytes. `crop` checks the transform of each image of an `image` or `media` value (decision 0031).

type.description: A built-in field type, or a type provided by a plugin.

localized.description: The value is an object keyed by locale.

resource.description: `relation`: id of the related resource. `media`, `image`: id of a resource of kind `media`, or a list of them; without it, every library of the definition (decision 0027).

ratios.description: `image`: ratios the editor suggests. The `crop` rule enforces ratios (decision 0031).

rotate.description: `image`: whether the editor offers rotation and flips. Defaults to true.

focalPoint.description: `image`: whether the editor offers the focal point. Defaults to true.

transformBase.description: `image`: what a transform for one use starts from: the media's own transform (`media`, the default), the original file, or the user's choice in the editor (decision 0031).

from.description: `slug`: the field the slug is generated from.

check.description: The client checks the value with the backend as it is typed, with `POST /resources/{resource}/fields/{field}/check`: whether a `slug` is available, and its URL. A field at the top of the resource only.

display.description: Display used in lists, when it differs from the default one of the type.

types.description: `repeater`: typed blocks, each with its own fields.

label.description: The name of the style in the toolbar.

class.description: The class the style puts on the element: `big`. Several classes are separated by spaces.

element.description: The element the style applies to: `p` (the default), `h1` to `h6`, `blockquote`, `ul`, `ol` or `li`.

RichTextStyle.description:
A block style of a `richtext` field: a named class on a paragraph, a heading, a quote or a list (`

`).

toolbar.description: The toolbar, in order: `heading`, `style`, `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `superscript`, `subscript`, `code`, `link`, `bulletList`, `orderedList`, `blockquote`, `horizontalRule`, `clear`, `undo`, `redo`, `|` between groups, and the buttons of plugins. Clients skip the names they don't know.

headings.description: The heading levels the toolbar offers. Defaults to 2, 3 and 4.

newTab.description: Which links open in a new tab (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`): as the user chooses (the default), every link to another site, or none.

RichTextSettings.description: The `settings` of a `richtext` field. Its value is HTML. The toolbar only limits what users add: content that the field stores keeps its elements and attributes.

type.description: A built-in node type, or a type provided by a plugin.

component.description: `component`: a component provided by a plugin.

width.description: Width on a 12-column grid, inside a `row`.

LayoutNode.description: A node of a form layout. Containers (`row`, `column`, `section`, `tabs`, `tab`, `sidebar`) have `children`. Fields that no node references are appended at the end of the form.

field.description: The field shown in the column.

id.description: Id of a column that is not a field.

type.description: Built-in: `text`, `select`, `toggle`, `date`, `date-range`, `relation`. A `date-range` value is the bounds of a range: `filter[id][from]` and `filter[id][to]`, days (`2026-01-31`), both inclusive and both optional.

sorts.description: Fields the list can be sorted by.

defaultSort.description: Same format as the `sort` query parameter: `-published_at,title`.

pagination.description: `pages` (the default): numbered pages, with a total. `cursor`: the list follows `nextCursor` of each page with the `cursor` parameter, without page numbers, for large lists that the backend can't count (decision 0039).

message.description: ICU message. `{count}` is the number of items.

kind.description: `server` calls the action endpoint; `link` navigates; `client` runs a plugin handler.

queued.description: The action always answers `202` with a run.

dryRun.description: The backend answers dry runs of this action (`dryRun` in the request): lists ask it how many items of a query selection will be skipped. Without it, the UI never sends `dryRun`, since a backend that ignores it would run the action.

url.description: `link`: URL template, with `{id}` for the item.

route.description: `link`: name of a route in the definition.

abilities.description: `run`: whether the current user can run the action on the resource.

Action.description: An operation on one item, a selection, or the whole resource.

search.description: Whether the resource is in the global search. Defaults to whether its list has a search (`list.search`).

kind.description: What the resource is. `media`: a library of media (decision 0026), with a `file` field and a `media` on each item. Without it, an ordinary resource. Clients treat a kind they don't know as an ordinary resource.

itemTitle.description: The field used as the title of an item, in lists and pickers.

itemSubtitle.description: The field shown under the title of an item, in search results, cards and pickers.

itemImage.description: The field that holds the image of an item (a media or a URL), in search results, cards and pickers.

types.description: Variants of the resource, each with its own extra fields.

Resource.description: A set of items managed in the admin.

resource.description: The resource of users: its item with this `id` is the profile of the user. Without it, clients look for a resource `users`.

url.description: Where the login with this provider starts.

label.description: Label of the field. Defaults to "Token".

help.description: Help under the field: where to find it.

mode.description: `panneau`: Panneau's own login pages. `external`: the site handles login.

logoutUrl.description: `external`: where the browser goes to log out, the site's own logout. Without it, the app offers no logout.

password.description: `panneau`: a login with an email and a password. Defaults to true without `token`.

token.description: `panneau`: a login with a single secret, such as an access token, sent as `token` to `POST /auth/login`.

component.description: A page provided by a plugin, or a built-in page.

params.description: Names of the path segments after the page: `["id"]` makes `{basePath}/pages/{page}/{id}`. The component gets them as `params`, and route references (`{ "route": "<page>", "params": { "id": … } }`) can link to the page. A page with `params` is not in menus.

mode.description: `multipart`: files go through `POST /media` and the requests that take them. `presigned`: the browser also sends files to storage itself, with URLs that `POST /uploads/sign` signs, then `POST /uploads/{upload}/complete` gives an upload that values reference.

endpoint.description: `presigned`: the base URL of the upload routes, when they are not `{api.baseUrl}/uploads`.

ThemeTokens.description: CSS variables without the leading `--`, and their values: `{ "panneau-color-accent": "#05f" }`. Values cannot contain `{`, `}`, `;` or `<`.

solidHover.description: Background of the solid appearance on hover.

anyOf.description: One color, from which Panneau derives the others.

solidHover.description: Background of the solid appearance on hover.
Background of the solid appearance on hover.

ToneInput.description: A tone: one color, or every value with dark scheme overrides.

ThemeFontFace.description: A font face, written as an `@font-face` rule.

ThemeFontStylesheet.description: A hosted stylesheet that declares font faces.

tokens.description: Tokens of the light scheme, or of both schemes when `dark` does not set them.

dark.description: Tokens that change in the dark scheme.

palette.description: Raw colors, written as `--panneau-palette-<name>`: tokens and tones use them with `var(--panneau-palette-<name>)`.

tones.description: Tones added or redefined by the theme, applied by `panneau-tone-<name>`.

components.description: Named variants of components: tokens applied by `panneau-<component>-variant-<name>`.

densities.description: Tokens of each density (`panneau-control-height`…), which change with the density of the root.

fonts.description: Font faces and font stylesheets, added to the page once.

Theme.description: A theme of `@panneau/ui`, as plain data (decision 0024).

tokens.description: Tokens of the light scheme, or of both schemes when `dark` does not set them.

dark.description: Tokens that change in the dark scheme.

palette.description: Raw colors, written as `--panneau-palette-<name>`: tokens and tones use them with `var(--panneau-palette-<name>)`.

tones.description: Tones added or redefined by the theme, applied by `panneau-tone-<name>`.

components.description: Named variants of components: tokens applied by `panneau-<component>-variant-<name>`.

densities.description: Tokens of each density (`panneau-control-height`…), which change with the density of the root.

fonts.description: Font faces and font stylesheets, added to the page once.

extends.description: Themes registered by plugins, by id, that this theme builds on, in order: its own values override theirs.

DefinitionTheme.description: The theme of the admin: a theme, built on themes of plugins.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale of the labels and messages.

routes.description: Named paths of the frontend, for `link` actions and redirects.

Definition.description: Everything a frontend needs to render the admin for the current user.

version.description: Changes on every update. `null` when the backend has no versions.

Item.description: An item of a resource. Its other properties are the values of its fields.

nextCursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page, or `null` on the last page.

previousCursor.description: The `cursor` of the previous page, or `null` when it is the first page, which has none (and on the first page). Without it, clients go back through the cursors they followed.

total.description: How many items match, when the backend counts them.

CursorPagination.description: The meta of a page of a list whose `pagination` is `cursor`: no page numbers, and no total unless the backend has one.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

errors.description: `422`: messages keyed by the dot path of the invalid value.

current.description: `412`: the current version of the item.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

filter.description: The `filter` of the list query, by filter id: a value, a list of values, or the bounds of a range (`{ "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-01-31" }`).

selection.description: Omitted for actions on the whole resource.

dryRun.description: Answer what the action would do without running it: a `200` action result whose `summary` counts the items that would succeed and those that would be skipped. Only for actions with `dryRun: true`.

results.description: The items that did not succeed.

result.description: Set once the run has finished.

crop.description: In whole pixels of the upright original image (after its EXIF orientation), from its top left corner.

focalPoint.description: From 0 to 1, relative to the width and height of the upright original image, not of the crop: changing the crop does not move it. Renderers map it into the transformed image and clamp it to the crop.

base.description: What a transform for one use starts from: the original file by default, or the media's own transform (`media`). With `media`, the crop and the focal point are relative to the media's version instead of the original (decision 0031).

baseTransform.description: With `base: "media"`: the media's own transform this one was made on. When the media's transform is no longer the same, clients ask to check the crop, and renderers clamp it.

MediaTransform.description: Non-destructive edits of an image, applied in this order: crop, then rotate, then flip. Renderers ignore the keys they don't know, which editor tools can add.

name.description: The name of the file, as the user knows it.

url.description: Where to download it. A private file gets a temporary URL.

StoredFile.description: A file stored by the backend: the value of a `file` field in items. Requests send it back to keep the file, `{ "upload" }` to replace it, or `null` to remove it.

UploadReference.description: A file uploaded directly to storage, by the id of its upload: in a file value, such as the `file` of a media, or an action parameter.

key.description: The key of the object in storage.

Upload.description: A file the browser uploaded to storage, before it becomes a media, an import or another value.

UploadSignRequest.description: A request of the browser's S3 client to sign (Uppy 6's `signRequest`).

key.description: The key the backend chose, for the first request of a file.

headers.description: Headers the URL was signed with, which the browser sends.

upload.description: The upload the first request of a file created: `upl_…`.

value.description: The value to check, as it is typed.

locale.description: The locale of the value, for a localized field.

id.description: The item being edited, or null when creating one.

values.description: The form's current values, as they would be sent to save, for what the check depends on (a page's parent).

FieldCheckRequest.description: A value of a field with `check`, to check with the backend.

available.description: Whether no other item of the resource, in its scope and the same locale, has the value.

suggestion.description: An available value close to the one checked, when it is taken.

prefix.description: What the field shows in front of the value: the start of its URL.

url.description: The URL the value gives the item, which the field links to.

disabled.description: The field doesn't apply to this item (the home page has no slug): the field is read-only.

FieldCheckResponse.description: What the backend says about a value: not authoritative, since saving still validates it.

type.description: `image`, `video`, `audio`, `document`, `font`, or another type the backend knows.

url.description: The main file to show or play: a rendition, or the original until it exists.

variants.description: Named renditions: sizes of an image, qualities of a video.

status.description: Where the processing of the file is: `pending` and `processing` until its renditions are made, then `ready` or `failed`. Without it, the media is ready.

error.description: Why the processing failed, when `status` is `failed`, so that editors see it without the backend's monitoring.

code.description: The code of the step that failed, such as a transcoder task code (`timeout`, `input_unreadable`).

transform.description: The media's own transform, from its library, which clients need to draw a transform for one use made over it (decision 0031).

MediaInfo.description: What the backend computed about the file of a media item: the `media` of the items of a `media` resource, and of the values of `media` fields. Read-only: the editable properties of a media are the fields of its resource.

version.description: Changes on every update. `null` when the backend has no versions.

MediaItem.description: An item of a resource of kind `media`: the values of its fields (`file`, the original, and those of the project), and the `media` the backend computed.

resource.description: The library of the media. Required for a field that allows several libraries, since ids are unique only within their resource (decision 0027).

transform.description: The edits of the image for this use only: from the original file, or over the media's own transform with `base: "media"`.

MediaReference.description: The value of a `media` or `image` field in items: the media, with what lists and fields show, and its edits for this use. Requests send the id, or `{ id, resource, transform }`: `resource` is required when the field allows several libraries.

total.description: How many items of the resource match, when the backend counts them: the list of the resource, searched, shows them all.

SearchResponse.description: The results of the global search: the resources with results, in the order of the definition.

url.description: The URL of the video, sound or post.

html.description: The HTML that embeds it, from the oEmbed of its provider.

EmbedValue.description: The value of an `embed` field: its URL, and what the backend got from its oEmbed.

LocationValue.description: The value of a `location` field: a point, and its address.
